plan.notes: Source: Otterbein University Department of Biology and Earth Science official 'Suggested Program of Study' for the Environmental Science Major (BS). SUGGESTED SEQUENCE — explicitly a suggested program of study. No explicit catalog year on the document; the PDF footer carries revision stamp 2/18/26, so catalog year is recorded as 2025-2026. Credit ranges resolved at minimums with disclosure: 'BIO/EHS/ESCI Elective 3-4' slots at 3; SYE 2-3 at 2; 'ESCI 4950 Research (optional)' transcribed at 3 per footnote f (a completed thesis may substitute as a 3-4 credit upper-level elective) — the source prints no credit on that row and a spring-senior term total of 12-15, while the row-by-row minimums sum to 15; the discrepancy is disclosed here. Term totals as transcribed (minimums): 17+16+16+15+13.5+13.5+15+15 = 121. The source requires 120 hours to graduate (footnote g); the source prints junior-year term totals of 14-15 (row-by-row minimums sum to 13.5). Fourteen upper-level hours required with at least 8 in ESCI, and 3-4 hours from BIO 3020, BIO 3320, ESCI 3000, ESCI 3100, or ESCI 4950/BIO 4998 WI (footnote e). Courses marked '(skills)'/'(recommended)' carry the source's annotations. PHYS 1100/1500 and PHYS 1200/1600 are alternative lecture+lab pairs (1500/1600 requires calculus). No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence left empty. BIO 3998 is taken in both semesters of junior year by program design (two semesters required per source footnote c); allow_repeated_courses is set.
